Actually I wanted: out. CNAME deep.x. Let me instead make the zone `out.` contain a record at `w.out.` and have b.test. point to `w.out.`.

Hmm, but I wanted to test the EXTERNAL path: a CNAME chain that ends at a name outside all zones after ≥1 follow. Let me use: test. zone: a.test. CNAME b.test.; b.test. CNAME out. (no zone for "out."). Then EXTERNAL at "out." with followed=2. And a separate query for the REFUSED path.

Let me fix T4.
